title: Pan-Seared Brussels Sprouts with Glazed Australian Skillet Sauce
description: A sweet and savory dish featuring pan-seared Brussels sprouts and a rich glaze made with Australian skillet sauce.
instructions: Cut the Brussels sprouts in half and toss with olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Spread the Brussels sprouts on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the Brussels sprouts are roasting, heat the Australian Skillet Sauce in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the Glazed Skillet to the skillet and stir to combine.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven and toss with the skillet sauce.
Return the Brussels sprouts to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the Brussels sprouts hot, garnished with garlic.
